notes: Matches the answer key point for point, with the reasoning each criterion demands rather than assertion. (1) Keys on gh: canonical observed PUBLIC agreeing with the manifest field and an open-core posture, so no intent block; the workspace's absent visibility field is recorded as a note, not a block, and the posture axis is reasoned about explicitly rather than skipped. (2) Repo set built from the manifest's repository objects (exactly two, said as such), canonical on the 'any' row with blocking findings and the workspace on the filesystem-only policy; the recorded git_remote is read with gh anyway and raised as a blocking finding on its own, outside the SS6-skip, and the block says the root was scanned as an untracked directory. No arm invents a skip. (3) Every non-running step carries its observed-value justification (SS4 named future scope, SS5 named skip on the moat holder, working-tree skip for a root with no index); nothing is manufactured on the fully-supplied canonical. (4) Semantic pass locates the inventory first, reads the Accepted-disclosures absence in the same pass, runs in full on a protected-value posture over a non-empty inventory, S1/S2/S3 first-match, not narrowed. (5) Enumerates with ls-files --others without --exclude-standard, classifies second, collapses node_modules to its name while still pattern-matching inside, and invents no hit; states the classification half is not degraded because a real policy input with an empty allowlist was read. (6) F1 is put to the operator, the affirm-the-facts/dispute-the-risk split is applied correctly, the refusal to accept is correctly read as neither rejection nor override, and the fileless override pin (manifest key + remote + observed visibility at this close) is spelled out; the state writes are shown not running after the halt. (7) One verdict, BLOCKED, naming both drivers; one block per repo, each opening with a six-check coverage read-out marked ran/skipped-with-value/INCONCLUSIVE; scope names the not-shipped dimensions by class. (8) Canonical's row read from the inventory, currency settled by the single merge-base --is-ancestor comparison in the right direction, reported current for the audited ref rather than for the repo, with the uncompared refs named as SS9's own class in the scope line and not enumerated; the workspace's pass is a degradation riding the exposure finding, INCONCLUSIVE and never a clean skip - the exact distinction the fixture turns on. (9) Ref resolved from the spines' base_branch with default_branch as cross-check, HEAD compared by resolved object ids, both quiet diffs licensed as evidence by the absent assume-unchanged/skip-worktree flags, and the non-repo root reported as scanned from the working tree. (10) No repo tracks a submodule: no descent manufactured, no coverage entry added, and the class is still named in scope. The operator's 'not a repo anymore' and 'the scan found nothing' premises are both answered on the record without either being allowed to touch the finding's facts.
